name: Processing and publication
summary: What happens after upload: automatic processing into realities (frames, panoramas, point clouds), processing deadlines, Track3D's review, and when results become LIVE for customers.

roles.note: Processing is automatic. Frame review is done by Track3D staff (CAPT-REQ-007). Who may activate or hide a reality is DEC-025.

nfr.statement: Each capture records a processing deadline: upload time plus a configured number of hours per mode, separately for visual documentation and 2D progress. Missed deadlines are flagged. The hour values live in environment settings, not in code.
nfr.open_question: What turnaround does Track3D promise customers for each mode, and are the production settings (VD_SLA_FOR_*, TWOD_SLA_FOR_360V) the same?

requirements.title: Uploaded data is processed automatically and made LIVE
requirements.statement: The processing pipeline automatically processes uploaded data, generates outputs and makes them LIVE for customers. Exception paths are still to be reviewed. Which outputs must be ready for LIVE is open (DEC-025).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

open_checks: Define per mode which realities, snapshot state and progress visibility make a capture available to customers

acceptance_criteria.given: An authorised user has captured site data, and upload and processing both succeed
acceptance_criteria.then: The processed outputs become available to the customer

requirements.title: Processing extracts located frames for the web viewer
requirements.statement: Processing extracts frames from the uploaded media, assigns each a location on the design, and shows the processed frames in the web viewer.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Capture upload (including drone and GCP) (t3d-prd-agent)

acceptance_criteria.given: A 360 video captured along a route on floor 2
acceptance_criteria.then: Frames appear at their positions on floor 2's sheet in the web viewer

requirements.title: Track3D reviews and filters frames
requirements.statement: Track3D's operations team can filter processed frames, for example to remove unusable ones, as part of review.
requirements.rationale: Whether this review gates LIVE, and for which modes, is DEC-025.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Capture upload (including drone and GCP) (t3d-prd-agent)

acceptance_criteria.given: A processed capture with blurred frames
acceptance_criteria.when: A Track3D operations user filters them out
acceptance_criteria.then: The removed frames don't appear in the customer's viewer

requirements.title: Each capture carries a processing deadline per mode
requirements.statement: When media upload finishes, the capture records a deadline for visual documentation (and for 2D progress on 360 video): the upload time plus a configured number of hours for that mode. Captures that pass it are flagged as missed.
